about_the_game:
Story setting

More than a decade ago, a brainwashing organization named "Shengwei Research Association" lured followers under the guise of "scientific research," secretly amassing wealth and causing adverse social impacts. Its mastermind was ultimately sentenced to death.

More than a decade later, the "Dimensional Upgrade Research Society" unexpectedly made a comeback, indirectly causing the deaths of many people. Strangely, each incident was disguised as an accident or the voluntary action of the parties involved, yet the public opinion was all directed towards the "Inference Club" of Ziyi University

As a resident of Huazhuo Community, you accidentally discover unusual circumstances in your neighborhood. Through continuous investigation, you uncover numerous clues and, with the assistance of several characters, reveal the truth of the matter... However, the finger of truth points to an unexpected person

Game tags

Near-future worldview/romance/suspense/mild horror/slight deduction elements

All main characters in this game are adults

Character Introduction

Ling Du

The all-round bionic human produced by Jianxin Company ten years ago, with a color scheme reminiscent of blue sky and white clouds, represents Jianxin Company's broad and beautiful expectations for the future of bionic humans. Due to a setting issue, it always has a catchphrase of "dinglingling", with a cute and obedient personality, occasionally speaking with a bit of quirkiness.

"Zero, I also want to protect my master, forever and ever...! This is not a system setting, but Zero's own consciousness."

Jin Zhao

Your older brother, Xun Zhou, majored in forensic medicine at university. He was adopted by your family when he was two and a half years old. At the age of eighteen, he was forced to leave by his father. Later, he reunited with you. He appears gentle and polite on the surface, but in reality, he is scheming and has a hidden personality trait of delusional coquettishness.

"In my heart, my sister's smile is the most beautiful existence in the world."

　　

Wen Che

The eldest son of the Wen family, his mother is the CEO of Jianxin Company, and his father is a renowned author. He is studying Finance at Ziyi University and also serves as the president of the student union. He is obsessed with internal competition, extremely persistent in achieving good grades, excels in both academics and moral conduct, is skilled in interpersonal communication, appears lively and cheerful, but often conceals his true thoughts.

"Haha, don't be fooled by my usual eloquence. When it comes to love, I'm a total novice..."

Wen Yan

The second son of the Wen family, whose mother is the CEO of Jianxin Company and father is a renowned writer, was once the darling of the world. However, he suffered a major blow when he was kidnapped in high school, leading to the development of dissociative identity disorder. Since then, he has fallen from grace, been ostracized by his classmates, and has been on medical leave from school. He appears arrogant on the surface, but in reality, this is a facade to conceal his inner humility and loneliness.

The secondary personality, named Wen Zhao, remains stuck in the period of being kidnapped, maintaining a wary attitude towards the surrounding environment and often exhibiting emotions of fear and sadness.

"Who's jealous? Do you think I like you...? My face is red because, because... it's too hot!"

　　

Chi Qiu

Chi Qiu, a student from Huagang High School, tragically passed away in a car accident. Deeply grieving for their son, Chi Qiu's parents decided to pursue cloning. Thus, the cloned person "Chi Qiu" was born, living in this world as Chi Qiu. However, due to not meeting their expectations, he was abandoned by his parents. During his wandering, you found him.

Physically weak and constitutionally poor, one is prone to illness. In life, there is a severe lack of common sense, and one often feels confused about the meaning of their existence.

"I don't want to leave... because you are the entirety of my world..."

　　

Song Mei

Your stepmother loves roses, flower tea, and poetry. She is intellectual and elegant, shrewd in her dealings, and occasionally enjoys a good time. She "faux married" your father for economic cooperation and seems very enthusiastic about you.

Having graduated from a top domestic university with a major in medicine, he later studied abroad and has now returned to work in China. His recent actions are very suspicious, and perhaps there are many secrets hidden within them?

"The roses will always bloom for you, my dear butterfly. This is our story, the story of roses and butterflies."

short_description: As a college student renting in Huazhuo Residential Area, you begin to sense something unsettling beneath its ordinary surface. Slowly, the eerie atmosphere seeps into your daily life, pulling you into a hidden conspiracy—until you uncover its terrifying truth.
